title: Space’s Vanilla Tweaks
description: Vanilla-like resource pack with few changes that enhance the look of some items.
body:
Resource pack made by SpaceBay with minimal, vanilla-like changes to various PvP items.
Changes include:
- Longer Diamond Sword
- Longer Netherite Sword
- 3D Mace
- 3D Wind Charges
- Lower Shield (and to the side)
- Purple Hotbar
